start: Owner signed in, gym online, the gym server has Training progress, at least one member shares workouts from the app

steps.action: Open Training progress from the menu
user_sees: Title 'Training progress'
Subtitle 'Every member who shares their workouts, and their trainer'
'Loading…' only on the first read
One card per member: name, one plain line in a pill, 'Trainer: {name}' or 'No trainer'
'{n} workouts in 12 weeks' and 'Workouts per week, last 12 weeks' beside a small line chart
Last line: 'Members can switch sharing off in their app at any time. Body weight, photos and notes are never shared.'
must_not: A member who does not share workouts is listed
Body weight, photos or notes are shown
'1 workouts in 12 weeks' for one workout
A blank page with no word while reading

steps.action: Scroll until a member card is on screen
user_sees: A tag appears on that card (Getting stronger, Steady, Dropping or Not enough data yet)
Beside it, when known: '{name}: strength score {before} → {now} kg' or '{name}: most reps {before} → {now}'
must_not: Every member's workouts are read at once on a long list
A tag shown for a member with no recent workouts

steps.action: Tap 'Send: Well done' on one card
user_sees: The button says 'Sending…' and both buttons are greyed
Under the buttons, in green: 'Sent. It is in their app now.'
must_not: WhatsApp opens
The message goes to any other member
Two messages from one tap
'Sent' shown when the send failed

start: Training progress list, a member who is on the gym's member list

steps.action: Tap the member's name, or 'See full progress'
user_sees: A page titled with the member's name
Subtitle 'Training progress · Trainer: {name}' (or 'Training progress' with no trainer)
'Loading…', then the member's full progress
Buttons 'Back to Training progress' and 'Open member page'
must_not: Another member's progress opens
Body weight, photos or notes appear
An endless Loading

steps.action: Tap 'Back to Training progress'
user_sees: The list again, with the same members
must_not: The list is empty or reads from scratch with an error

steps.action: Open the same member page by typing its address in the browser
user_sees: The same page for that member
must_not: A blank page
A page for a member of another gym

start: Owner on Training progress; cases where it cannot work

steps.action: Tap 'Send: How’s it going?' for a member who has left the app
user_sees: In red under the buttons: 'This member is not on the MettleUp app any more.'
must_not: 'Sent. It is in their app now.'
A message kept for a person who is no longer there

steps.action: Look at a card of an app member who is not on the gym's member list
user_sees: No link on the name
'This member is not on your gym’s list yet, so their full progress cannot open.'
must_not: A 'See full progress' button that opens an empty page

steps.action: Open Training progress with a gym that is not online
user_sees: 'Training progress needs your gym online'
'Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
must_not: A list from another gym
An endless Loading

steps.action: Open it on a gym whose server does not have this part yet
user_sees: 'Training progress is not ready for your gym yet'
'It will appear here once your gym’s server has it.'
must_not: A red error
An empty list that looks like no member trains

steps.action: Open it with the internet off
user_sees: A red line with the reason
A 'Try again' button
must_not: A blank page
Old figures shown as fresh

start: Owner on Training progress; the gym already sent this member 2 messages today

steps.action: Tap 'Send: Well done'
user_sees: 'Sent to their app. No phone notification this time: your gym already sent 2 messages today.'
must_not: A third phone notification today
The plain 'Sent. It is in their app now.' line

steps.action: Tap 'Send: Well done' again on the same card
user_sees: A second message is sent, with its own Sent line
must_not: The card freezes on Sending…

steps.action: The member switches sharing off in the app; the owner taps Refresh in the top bar
user_sees: The member is gone from the list
The list does not jump to the top or go blank while reading
must_not: The member still listed with old figures
The open member page closes by itself

steps.action: Open that member's progress page by its address
user_sees: 'This member is not sharing workouts from the MettleUp app. They can switch on “Share my workouts with my trainers” in the app’s settings.'
must_not: Old workouts still shown after sharing was switched off

start: Owner on Training progress, a member who shares and one who does not

steps.action: Read every card and one full progress page
user_sees: Workout counts, best lifts and the weekly line only
'Body weight, photos and notes are never shared.'
must_not: Body weight, a photo or a note of any member
A member who never switched sharing on
A member of another gym or branch

steps.action: Send a ready message
user_sees: It goes to that one member's app
must_not: The message is visible to other members
The member's phone number is shown or used
A WhatsApp is sent

start: A desk person the owner ticked as Trainer, signed in, gym online, the owner gave them two members who share workouts

steps.action: Open Training progress from the menu
user_sees: Title 'Training progress'
Subtitle 'Your members: who to talk to today'
Only the members the owner gave this trainer
No 'Trainer:' pill on the cards
must_not: A member of another trainer
A member with no trainer
Body weight, photos or notes

steps.action: Read one card to the end
user_sees: The plain line, the 12-week chart and the tag
'See full progress'
In place of the two send buttons: 'Only the gym owner can send these from here for now.'
must_not: A 'Send: Well done' button that then fails
An empty space where the buttons would be

steps.action: Tap a member's name or 'See full progress'
user_sees: The member's name as the title, subtitle 'Training progress'
The member's full progress
'Back to Training progress', 'Open member page'
must_not: The trainer's name shown as 'Trainer: …' as if for the owner
Progress of a member who is not theirs

start: A desk person WITHOUT the Trainer tick, and a trainer who types the address of another trainer's member

steps.action: Desk person without the tick opens Training progress
user_sees: 'Only trainers and the owner see this'
'Ask the owner to tick you as a trainer in Staff & sign-in.'
must_not: Any member card
A red error

steps.action: A trainer types the progress address of a member who belongs to another trainer
user_sees: 'Only the owner and this member’s own trainer can see this.'
must_not: Any workout of that member
The member's name in the title

start: Trainer with one member; then the owner changes things

steps.action: The owner gives the member to another trainer; the first trainer taps Refresh
user_sees: The member is gone from the list
must_not: The member stays until sign-out
The full progress page still opens from an old link

steps.action: The trainer now has no members
user_sees: 'No members to show yet'
'The owner gives you members on each member’s page. They show here once they use the MettleUp app.'
must_not: A blank page
The owner's wording about giving trainers

steps.action: The owner removes the Trainer tick; the person taps Refresh
user_sees: 'Only trainers and the owner see this'
must_not: The old list stays on screen

steps.action: Read the list and one full progress page
user_sees: Only their own members, only shared workout facts
must_not: Body weight, photos, notes
Fees, dues or phone numbers that the desk role may not see
Members of other trainers
